title: CWP/6995/2025 of JASWINDER PAL SINGH Vs PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LIMITED THROUGH ITS SECRETARY
respondents: Punjab State Power Corporation Limited Through Its Secretary
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 113 CWP-6995-2025 (O&M) Date of decision : 24.03.2025 JASWINDER PAL SINGH ...... Petitioner VERSUS PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LIMITED THROUGH ITS SECRETARY & OTHERS ...... Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present :- Mr. Arvind Galav, Advocate for the petitioner. Deepinder Singh Nalwa, J. (Oral)

1. In the present writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the reply dated 05.08.2024 (Annexure P-20) to the legal notice dated 31.07.2023 (Annexure P-15).

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in fact a perusal of the reply to the legal notice dated 05.08.2024 (Annexure P-20) would show that the reply reflects that reply has been filed by the counsel and not by the Competent Authority. The counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that in fact the Competent Authority has not even considered the legal notice while giving reply as such, the same is liable to be quashed.

3. Notice of motion.

4. Mr. Jatinder Singh Gill, Advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondents and on instructions from Ms. Anita Rani, Deputy Secretary RIMPAL RANI 2025.03.25 14.47 (Establishment) submits that a decision has been taken by the Competent I CWP-6995-2025 :2: Authority to pass a fresh order by taking into consideration the contention raised in the legal notice served by the petitioner 31.07.2023 (Annexure P15), and a fresh order will be passed in accordance with law.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that keeping in view the statement of learned counsel for the respondents, the present petition may kindly be disposed of having been not pressed any further.

6. Ordered accordingly.

7. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of accordingly. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) JUDGE 24.03.2025 Rimpal RIMPAL RANI 2025.03.25 14.47 I
